decision: Drop of 30 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 5th Engine (ICE) 5th Turbocharger (TC) 4th MGU-K
offence: Breaches of Articles B8.2.2 (read with B8.2.3) of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Drop of 30 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article B8.2.8a of the FIA F1 Regulations. The use of each additional element in this case carries a 10 grid place penalty therefore there is an accumulation of 30 places. Subject to Car 11 being classified in the results of Qualifying, Car 11 will be allocated a grid position in the Race in accordance with Article B2.5.4b.iv of the FIA F1 Regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 11 Changes To Pu Elements
to: The Team Manager, Cadillac Formula 1 Team
